_comment: Mean micro-time imaging tool. AutoForm over MicroTimeViewModel: a Controls dock (file + photon threshold; actions in the toolbar) and per-pixel Intensity / Mean micro-time map docks (reusable `image` section). The detector-window selector lives in each map (channel combo); the Frames dock plays the raw per-frame intensity stack. The mean micro-time is computed for every detector window from step-0 Setup.

sections.label: TTTR file
sections.description: PTU/HT3 imaging file; CLSM markers are auto-detected from the header.

sections.label: Min. photons
sections.description: Pixels with fewer photons than this are discriminated (set to 0); press Run to apply.
